auditedPlan: First remove overlapping native-goal lifecycle in BGS-owned workflows using the existing feature switch, after local new/resume config tests. Keep BGS automatic continuation and accounting; no promise of large token reduction.
Keep current correct output budget and contract query entrances. Do not restore truncation as a cost cap, add mandatory review rounds or make game semantics into BGS rules.

Treat drafting, review and cost as separate outcomes. Existing Skills already cover checks and proportionality; this evidence does not justify adding more instructions or claiming autonomous self-review is reliable.

For cost reduction, assess the length and breadth of the requested documents against actual downstream decisions and remove repetitive prose in existing guidance only where a mandatory source requirement can be demonstrated. No arbitrary token target or hard stop is validated by this audit.
Investigate update_plan only with local captured request/tool schema reproduction if pursued; session metadata alone is insufficient.

implementationFollowup.clarification: Earlier wording that BGS has its own automatic continuation loop was imprecise. workflow-v3/agent-goal.ts explicitly has no automatic model retries or stage advancement. Existing in-turn execution and explicit follow-up/resume remain. This change disables native persistent-goal continuation, not a duplicate BGS retry implementation.
